metadata.description: Stage 3 Security Testing — P²IM pass 2 (related work, run directly): feed the corpus to P²IM with no Stage 2 admission premise, to document that this dataset does not run on P²IM. P2IMGateway guesses the board/MCU and writes fuzz.cfg under p2im_on_real_fw/<id>/, P2IMRunner drives P²IM's model instantiation, AFL and the coverage count. Runs after 03b_p2im_elf and forks that pass's project; it imports convert_elf_results.elf_path, so it must not be merged with the ELF pass (dbImports are resolved when the run starts). A firmware P²IM cannot instantiate ends as FAILED_EARLY_ABORT, and the run continues: the failure of one firmware does not abort the others (measured: 32 of 33 firmware failed, all 33 were attempted). Table: p2im_fuzzing_results.
metadata.constraint: WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM convert_elf_results WHERE elf_path IS NOT NULL)
